[[File:Legend of the Five Rings LCG logo.png|thumb|Original Legend of the Five Rings LCG game logo.]]
'''Legend of the Five Rings''' is a two-player living card game in which rival clans defend their strongholds. The [[TCGMix]] playtest includes the seven clans from the 2017 core set, custom decks and bot opponents.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

Fantasy Flight Games introduced the game in 2017 after acquiring the property in 2015. The Core Set went on general sale on 5 October 2017, after a Gen Con prerelease.<ref name="l5catalog" /><ref name="l5intro" /> The Core Set rulebook credits Brad Andres, Erik Dahlman and Nate French for design and development.<ref name="l5rules" /> Fantasy Flight announced that ''Under Fu Leng’s Shadow'' would complete the line. The expansion went on sale on 18 June 2021.<ref name="l5future" /><ref name="l5last" />

== Gameplay ==

Players attack provinces in military or political conflicts and can win by breaking the opposing stronghold or gaining 25 honor.<ref name="l5rules" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/l5rlcg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-legend-of-the-five-rings-lcg">[https://tcgmix.com/l5rlcg/ Play Legend of the Five Rings LCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194738/https://tcgmix.com/l5rlcg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
